components.name: Immutable Audit Row
components.description: Preserves actor, event, evidence ID, time, and trace state.

narrative.overview: Incident Command AI feels like a physical command sheet enlarged into a live operational surface: warm paper, dark rules, a numbered clock, evidence moving through named sectors, and one unmistakable guarded action boundary. It refuses the generic analytics dashboard and autonomous-chatbot silhouette.
keyCharacteristics: Command-sheet materiality with near-black rules and warm paper surfaces.
Condensed incident typography paired with calm, readable operational text.
A large 24-hour command clock as the primary temporal anchor.
Signals, Impact, and Recovery as an explicit evidence progression.
Red reserved for severity, contradictions, and the protected execution boundary.
Synthetic provenance, evidence IDs, actors, and trace states remain visible.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, orange, and green communicate operational state; never use them as arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Compressed Authority Rule
rules.body: Condensed display type names operational objects; it does not carry paragraphs or nuanced evidence.

rules.name: The Protected Edge Rule
rules.body: The action gate owns the terminal edge of the decision flow.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Active Rule
rules.body: Depth is structural or state-driven; avoid floating ornamental panels.

dos: Do preserve the Signals → Impact → Recovery → Action Gate progression.
Do label every demonstration record as synthetic and retain its evidence ID and kind.
Do expose actor, timestamp, evidence ID, and trace state in immutable audit rows.
donts: Don't imitate ServiceNow's proprietary interface or use its logo.
Don't turn the product into a generic rounded-card dashboard or chat transcript.
Don't imply that a recommendation executed; the public demonstration records authorization but keeps the write disabled.
